title: 10 Laravel Tips That Will Save You Hours
excerpt: A practical guide on "10 Laravel Tips That Will Save You Hours" with real examples from my projects.
content:
In this post I share what I learned about 10 Laravel Tips That Will Save You Hours. These are practical lessons from real client work.

Most tutorials stop at the basics. Real projects need more: performance, maintainability and a good developer experience.

"Write code for humans first, computers second."

My approach:
- Start simple and measure
- Automate the boring parts
- Refactor with tests in place

Small, consistent improvements add up. Try one idea from this post in your next project.
